top_signals.title: Gold Dips as Traders Eye Dollar Recovery Against Yen, Fed Path
top_signals.summary: Gold fell as an intervention-driven rally in the yen stalled, helping the dollar snap a five-day run of losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hacker uses DeepSeek AI to autonomously attack vulnerable servers
top_signals.summary: A Chinese-speaking threat actor is using the DeepSeek AI model and the open-source Hermes Agent to conduct autonomous cyberattacks on exposed servers with limited human involvement. [...]
